name: 棕頸鴨

similarSpecies.distinction: 黑喙具鮮黃端，頭較淡、體色向後漸深，並非棕頸鴨的橙皮黃頭頸配灰喙。
繁殖羽雄鳥素褐灰頭、暗喙及白翼鏡，沒有棕頸鴨橙皮黃頭頸黑眼紋。

featureNotes: 橙皮黃面、灰喙具黑中央脊及黑甲
黑冠及黑眼紋夾橙皮黃色眉紋
褐翼淺羽緣及藍綠翼鏡；色澤隨角度改變
上頸橙皮黃色，往下接較淡褐灰胸

rangeMap.disclaimer: 綠色非全境；非完整分佈
rangeMap.note: World view native range Philippines endemic across major and some smaller islands. Only PHL highlighted, not all national territory occupied; rare vagrant HK and Taiwan records excluded from native range map. No exact occurrence or habitat polygons.

sources.use: Full page read: 48-58cm orange-buff eyebrow face/upper neck, black crown/eye stripe, dull brown fringed upperparts paler below, grey bill dark centre/nail; Philippines endemic, HK/Taiwan vagrant records; VU decreasing due hunting/wetland loss.
Substantive page read: yellow-tipped dark bill, pale head with dark crown/eye stripe, darkening rear body, white tertial edges, blue-green speculum with white borders.
Authoritative runtime scores; missing values remain blank; vEst flag means body length used for visibility is estimated.
Previously read full Gadwall page: subdued brown-grey male head dark bill, grey vermiculated body, black rear, white inner-secondary speculum.

notes: AI pictures received basic visual review, not independent ornithologist validation.
Comparison circles not to scale. Map overview is not an occurrence polygon.
Direct AVIF delivery to Google Drive only; no ZIP, R2 upload or UI/registration change.
Full world basemap restored at user request; highlighting is still a partial country overview, not a complete global species range.
Adult plumage, sexes similar; no male-specific green Mallard plumage substituted. Floating bird feet remain submerged, not used for feature circle.
Four crops show head/bill, crown/eyeline, folded wing and neck. Folded wing is not an in-flight panel illustration.
Map highlights native Philippines only, does not treat accidental Hong Kong/Taiwan records as normal native range. Runtime vEst=1 displayed.
